name: vns-umbraco-extensions-ufm
description: Umbraco 18 backoffice extension package with custom UFM filters and components (dateFormat, tagsFormat, badge, media), shipped as the NuGet package VNS.Umbraco.Extensions.

scripts.build: npm run version:sync && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run sync:wwwroot
scripts.pack: npm run build && dotnet pack nuget/VNS.Umbraco.Extensions.csproj -c Release -o nuget/artifacts
